unique_mathematical_solution: Put base square vertices at(0,0,0),(s,0,0),(s,s,0),(0,s,0). The ridge endpoints are(-s/2,s/2,h),(3s/2,s/2,h), forced by the four equal side edges and ridge length2s. Equal edges give h=s/sqrt2=6. At relative heightt a horizontal section is s(1+t) bys(1-t). Thus V=s^2*h*integral_0^1(1-t^2)dt=(2/3)*72*6=288. Reflection/rigid motion leaves this unique.
design_or_rejection_reason: No concrete concise appearance mechanism yields a stable numerical misread: outlining congruent triangular end faces may suggest a prism, but supplies no definite perpendicular prism length and would add many weakly useful edges. Skip instead of broad face salience.
